definitions.explanation: A small, agile bird with a forked tail, known for its swift flight and seasonal migration. Swallows are harbingers of spring in Japan.

examples.japanese: {燕|つばめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{軒下|のきした}→軒下：07850_nokishita⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巣|す}→巣：02140_su⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Swallows built a nest under the eaves.

examples.japanese: {燕|つばめ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捕|と}り→捕る：28715_toru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧。

notes:
{燕|つばめ} refers to swallows.

Alternative writing: ツバメ (katakana)

Common expressions:
- {燕|つばめ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{巣|す}→巣：02140_su⟧ (swallow's nest - also a Chinese delicacy)
- {燕|つばめ}⟦{返|がえ}し→燕返し：noentry⟧ (a sword technique; also a quick reversal)
- {燕|つばめ} (slang: a younger boyfriend of an older woman)

Counter: ⟦{羽|わ}→羽：01007_wa⟧

Cultural note:
Swallows nesting under the eaves of a house are considered good luck in Japan. People protect swallow nests and watch the chicks grow. The proverb 「{燕|つばめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}く→低い：02947_hikui⟧⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧」 (when swallows fly low, rain will fall) is a traditional weather prediction.

The Tsubame Sanjo area of Niigata is famous for metalwork, and the Shinkansen "Tsubame" serves Kyushu.
